notes.title: update 23/8/2025
notes.content:
- I added a fun thing for those who get Ending 2 by finding all the secret areas.
- I added the skeleton of a player who reported in the feedback widget in a funny way that he had fallen into infinity outside the map while desperately searching for the key.
- Many minor improvements and fixes.

Please keep reporting anything using the widget in-game or on Discord. I'll check back at least once a month for small fixes or updates!

Edd

notes.title: update 18/2/25
notes.content: made the time escape section easier to get through and lowered the difficulty of the challenges overall..

notes.title: update 8/2/25
notes.content:
fixed a setting that wouldn't play animations when on low quality and removed the need to activate the devices to make the terrible rock monster appear.

keep using the hub or in-game functionality to report if you run into any issues or anything and I'll take a look, thanks
Edd

notes.title: update 6/2/25
notes.content:
I added a system that removes vegetation or adjusts the resolution scale in case of low fps.

flowers and vegetation in some cases also indicate the path and are part of the gaming experience, this feature is designed only for older hardware where even with low quality settings you do not get fps higher than 30, if you notice that the vegetation disappears (a message is also written) check first in the settings if you are not using too high settings.

thanks to Nichoz for reporting, do not be afraid to use the hub to report anything!
Edd

notes.title: Update May 1 2024
notes.content: I added a couple of NPCs and puzzles, updated to directx 12 to support ray tracing, now it will automatically be active if the gpu supports it, and other little things.

I made some general improvements and some additions:

- some other game section/environments
- the paths you choose will affect the whole game
- added achievements, and added things to interact with
- made it clearer where the secret areas are
- some very simple puzzles
- some random event
- some other music
- other little things..

I hope you enjoy the update!

notes.title: update
notes.content:
a user reported a possible bug in the escape section, actually I didn't do anything different than before, I just reconstructed the AI path.. maybe this will work out for him.

But i tried all ways to reproduce the problem and on my side it works fine, so i think it was not a real bug. 

i can only guarantee it works fine on cards like gtx 1060 6gb higher or similar, it should also work with older cards with the right settings, but i have no way to test it.

however if anyone encounters something like this please report it to me and I'll have a look, 
https://steamcommunity.com/app/2195200/discussions/0/5350867208699106310/

thanks!
Edd
